name: W Suzhou
positioning: A design-led hotel in Suzhou Center near Jinji Lake, reinterpreting the city's architectural and garden heritage with glass-and-light installations, opera-inspired color and a Level 36 pool
best_for: Design lovers who want a playful, art-filled take on Suzhou
Business travelers and longer stays near Suzhou Center's offices

facts.text: Rooms have views of Suzhou or Jinji Lake.
Serviced apartments, accented with swirling color, are available for extended stays.
AWAY Spa offers eye treatments, facials, massages and body wraps.
W Suzhou is in Building 7 of Suzhou Center, near Jinji Lake, trendy shopping and corporate offices.
SOL37 is the hotel's gastro lounge.
Every room has a signature W bed with 400-thread-count linens.

highlights.text: W Suzhou's design is a modern interpretation of the city's architectural and verdant heritage, with playful installations of glass and light.
The hotel uses vibrant hues inspired by local opera and furnishings that appear to defy gravity.
AWAY Spa, FIT and the WET pool feature larger-than-life nature motifs.
The WET pool is on Level 36.

considerations.text: Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes the contemporary urban setting may lack a traditional Chinese cultural atmosphere.
